description: This file defines a class 'Volume' that implements volume-based technical indicators for chart plotting, including methods to add AD, ADOSC, and OBV indicators to a Plotly figure.

classes.name: Volume
classes.description: A class for plotting volume-related technical indicators such as AD, ADOSC, and OBV on a chart figure.

methods.name: plot_ad(self, fig: OpenBBFigure, df_ta: pd.DataFrame, subplot_row: int)
methods.description: Add the Accumulation/Distribution (AD) indicator to the plotly figure.

methods.name: plot_adosc(self, fig: OpenBBFigure, df_ta: pd.DataFrame, subplot_row: int)
methods.description: Add the On-Balance Volume (OBV) oscillator to the plotly figure.

methods.name: plot_obv(self, fig: OpenBBFigure, df_ta: pd.DataFrame, subplot_row: int)
methods.description: Add the On-Balance Volume (OBV) indicator to the plotly figure.
